assumptions.choice: Set initial trailing stop at EMA(8) value at signal time, and ratchet upward to max(previous_stop, EMA(8)) on each subsequent bar.
assumptions.reason: Spec states trailing stop lags by a distance equal to the 8-period EMA and moves upward without falling below previous values; placing ratcheted stop at EMA(8) satisfies all stated properties.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate exit conditions in next() using current bar High/Low prices and submit market orders upon condition detection.
assumptions.reason: Dynamic EMA trailing stop updates continuously, making per-bar intrabar extreme checks with market order submissions the standard Backtrader implementation choice.

assumptions.choice: Close max(1, position.size // 2) shares when TP1 threshold is reached.
assumptions.reason: Position size must be an integer number of shares; integer division with a minimum of 1 share handles odd-lot or single-share positions cleanly.
